EN: While exploring, Dwellers found a note warning everyone to stay away from an old industrial complex. If folks have kept clear, it might still hold something useful.
ZH: 探索的居民发现了一张告示，警告大家远离一幢旧的工业基地。如果没人在那儿，说不定还会有有用的东西留下。

EN: Factory Floor of Fear
ZH: 工厂惊魂

EN: Explore the industrial complex.
ZH: 探索工业基地。

EN: Explore a dangerous industrial area.
ZH: 探索一片危险的工业区域。

EN: Power Struggle
ZH: 权力斗争

EN: She's my grandma, but careful, she's a biter. Papa was too until he lost his dentures. They both mean well! Call it tough love.
ZH: 她是我的外婆，但是小心，她会咬人。我外公也是，直到他丢了他的假牙。当然他们都是好心，我称之为“强悍的爱”。

EN: Sure is, but careful, she's a biter. Papa used to be until he lost his dentures. But they both mean well! I call it tough love.
ZH: 当然是了。但小心，她爱咬人。老爸以前也这样，直到他丢了假牙。当然他们都是好意，我管这叫“严厉的爱”。

EN: Nana didn't tell me we were expecting guests!
ZH: 外婆没告诉我会有客人来。

EN: Oh my, I should have tidied up.
ZH: 哦我的天，我应该打扫一下的。

EN: Who is Nana?
ZH: 谁是外婆？

EN: Is that your grandmother?
ZH: 那是你的外婆吗？

EN: You came across a small cabin out in the Wasteland. Maybe someone still lives here.
ZH: 你经过废土上的一处小屋。说不定有人住在里面。

EN: Family Matters
ZH: 家人很重要

EN: Explore the Cabin.
ZH: 探索小屋。

EN: You've discovered an old Cabin out in the Wasteland.
ZH: 你在废土上发现一幢旧的小屋。

EN: With taste like that, you deserve to die!
ZH: 品位那么糟糕的话，真的应该去死！

EN: I knew it! But you're dead for noticing!
ZH: 我就知道！不过你既然注意到了，就应该死！

EN: What does a Vault Dweller know anyway? You're dead!
ZH: 一个避难所居民懂什么时尚。你死定了！

EN: Hey, Raiders can have fashion sense. I'll show you!
ZH: 拜托，掠夺者也可以懂时尚的好吗？我会让你明白的！

EN: This outfit is atrocious. Bare chested is so last year.
ZH: 这身装备糟糕透了。而且露胸的设计也太老土了吧。

EN: And I'm pretty sure these pants make my butt look big...
ZH: 而且我非常确定这些裤子让我的屁股显得更大了……

EN: Huh? Trespassers! How long have you been standing there?
ZH: 嗯？入侵者！你们站在这里多久了？

EN: Long enough. Spikes and leather are totally in by the way.
ZH: 很久了。顺便告诉你们，皮质和铆钉挺配的。

EN: You said it. Those pants do you no favors.
ZH: 你说的对呀，这些裤子丑爆了。

EN: I don't know, I think you look good.
ZH: 我不知道，但我觉得你看起来挺不错。

EN: You're a Raider. Who cares?
ZH: 你是个掠夺者，谁在乎你的样子？

EN: While exploring the Wasteland, one of your Dwellers came across a Red Rocket. Perhaps it's worth taking a look.
ZH: 一位居民在探索废土的时候发现了一处红火箭服务站。也许值得进去看一看。

EN: Fashion Statement
ZH: 时尚宣言

EN: Explore the Red Rocket.
ZH: 探索红火箭服务站。

EN: You came across an old Red Rocket!
ZH: 你发现了红火箭服务站！

EN: I think we can work out some kind of deal. Get it done and we'll talk.
ZH: 我想我们可以谈谈。你把事儿办了，咱们再商量报酬。

EN: Oh! Thanks, you're good people. Go get em!
ZH: 哦！谢谢你，你真是个好人。去吧，干掉他们！

EN: As long as you can afford it.
ZH: 只要你们付得起报酬就行。

EN: That's awful. I will do whatever I can! Those raiders have it coming.
ZH: 太过分了。我一定会帮你们的！那些掠夺者完蛋了。

EN: Hey! You ain't from around here. Hope you like the taste of lead!
ZH: 嘿！你是哪儿来的？想尝尝子弹的滋味吗？

EN: We've got a little bit of a Raider problem at the moment.
ZH: 我们这儿最近被掠夺者闹得鸡犬不宁。

EN: You look like you can handle yourself. You think you could...
ZH: 你看起来挺厉害的。你觉得你能……

EN: ...oust them from our little slice of heaven here?
ZH: ……把他们从咱们这儿赶走吗？

EN: Looks like you managed to take care of them all!
ZH: 看来你把那些掠夺者都收拾了！

EN: Welcome to Filly. I look out for this place. People call me Ma June.
ZH: 欢迎来到菲利镇。我负责保护这里，大家都叫我玛·琼。

EN: I've never seen a vault before. I think I might stop by.
ZH: 我从来没见过避难所。我想去看看。

EN: And here, fair wage for some outstanding work!
ZH: 这是你的报酬，干得不错！

EN: You've stumbled across a slipshod settlement called Filly, offering welcome to other wastelanders. Unfortunately, it seems to be occupied by a gang of raiders who have different ideas...
ZH: 你偶然来到了一个名为菲利的破败聚落，这个地方原本欢迎其他废土居民。不幸的是，这里似乎被一伙掠夺者占领了，他们有不同的想法……

EN: All Killy No Filly
ZH: 菲利之殇

EN: Clear out the Raiders for Ma June.
ZH: 帮助玛·琼清除那些掠夺者。

EN: Liberate the people of Filly.
ZH: 解放菲利居民。

EN: Nice flamethrower. Let's see if you know how to use it!
ZH: 火焰喷射器不错。倒要看看你到底会不会用！

EN: Everything's on fire! Kill 'em quick!
ZH: 全都着火啦！速战速决！

EN: Time to snuff you out, pyro!
ZH: 去死吧，你这个纵火狂！

EN: One of your Dwellers is a serial arsonist. We've decided to employ their talents outside the Vault.
ZH: 你的一位居民是一个连环纵火犯，我们决定将他的才能用在避难所之外的地方。

EN: Firestarter
ZH: 纵火者

EN: Kill the Raider Boss.
ZH: 消灭掠夺者首领。

EN: Send a lone Vault Dweller with a Flamethrower out to wreak havoc!
ZH: 派一位避难所居民带上火焰喷射器去制造大混乱吧！

EN: They were heading for a nearby building. I think they were searching for something.
ZH: 他们去了附近的一幢建筑。好像在找什么。

EN: Something to do with impressing their leader. Can you ask them yourself when you rescue my sister?
ZH: 大概和讨好他们老大有关。你们去救我妹妹的时候能亲自问问他们吗？

EN: Thank goodness! I was afraid nobody heard my signal.
ZH: 谢天谢地！我真担心根本没人听到我的信号。

EN: We were jumped by Raiders from a gang I've never seen before.
ZH: 一群掠夺者跳了出来挡住了我们，他们来自一个我从来没听过的帮派。

EN: They kept talking about something called the Super Cup.
ZH: 他们一直在谈论一个叫做“超级杯”的东西。

EN: They've got my sister. Please, you've got to help her!
ZH: 他们带走了我的妹妹。求求你们，一定要帮帮她！

EN: Do you know where they went?
ZH: 你知道他们去哪里了吗？

EN: The Super Cup?
ZH: 超级杯？

EN: A frantic voice comes in over the radio. There's a settler out in the Wasteland who's in serious trouble! The clock's ticking...
ZH: 一个焦急的声音从广播里传来。在废土上有个定居者貌似遇到了大麻烦！时间不多了……

EN: First Down
ZH: 第一次进攻

EN: Help the lost settler.
ZH: 帮助迷失的定居者。

EN: Help the lost settler.
ZH: 帮助迷失的定居者。

EN: Yes! That's the one. Left here and headed to that factory across the river to take out Road Rash and his gang of Raiders!
ZH: 没错！就是那个。离开这里然后去工厂，穿过小河，拿下“道路丘疹”和他那帮掠夺者团伙吧！

EN: He was heading towards the automobile factory to take out that Raider gang living there.
ZH: 他往汽车厂的方向去了，那群掠夺者就住在那里。

EN: Oh, thank goodness! Someone found us!
ZH: 哦，谢天谢地！终于有人找到了我们！

EN: You have to help us, that Minuteman left us before we could find a way out of here!
ZH: 你们必须帮帮我们——我们还没找到出去的路，那个义勇军民兵就撇下我们走了！

EN: Said someone else needed his help and disappeared.
ZH: 说是有其他的人需要帮助，然后就消失了。

EN: Was his name Preston?
ZH: 那个人的名字是叫普雷斯顿吗？

EN: Did he mention where he was going?
ZH: 他有说他会去哪儿吗？

EN: Famed Minuteman, Preston Garvey, has gone missing! Search for clues to his whereabouts at his last known location.
ZH: 小有名气的义勇军民兵——普雷斯顿·加维，消失了！在他最后出现的地方寻找有关他去向的线索。

EN: Following His First Steps
ZH: 追寻他最初的脚步

EN: Search the office building for clues.
ZH: 搜寻办公楼找线索。

EN: Kill the Raider Boss.
ZH: 消灭掠夺者首领。

EN: Search for clues to Preston Garvey's location.
ZH: 寻找有关普雷斯顿下落的相关线索。

EN: We tried to save some but it was so REFRESHING! Try Vault 315, they bought some as well.
ZH: 我们试图节约一些，但它是如此清爽！去315号避难所看看吧，他们也买了一些。

EN: Incredible! We bought a bottle of his water for only 10,000 caps and everything got fixed!
ZH: 简直不可思议！我们只用10000瓶盖买了一瓶他的水，一切都解决了！

EN: Margo's eczema cleared up, the crop came in full... even our brahmin Ole Jess don't limp no more!
ZH: 马格的湿疹好了，作物也长齐了……甚至我们的双头牛奥利·杰斯也不再一瘸一拐了！

EN: We even sprinkled some on door hinges, and that annoying squeak is gone!
ZH: 我们甚至在门铰链上洒了一些，讨厌的吱吱声居然消失了！

EN: He truly is the Wizard of Water!
ZH: 他真的是水之术士！

EN: You wouldn't happen to have any left over, would you?
ZH: 你们不会恰好还有点剩的吧？

EN: People are talking about a new kind of water that has healing properties, makes you stronger and brings good fortune. Adventure! Action! Refreshing Beverages! We can drink to that!
ZH: 人们在谈论一种新的水，它具有治疗特性，能使你更强壮并带来好运。冒险！行动！提神的饮料！这一点值得我们干一杯！

EN: Fons Vivus
ZH: 活水

EN: Talk to settlers who've tried the magical new water.
ZH: 与那些尝试过神奇的新水的定居者们交谈。

EN: Learn more about the magical water people are talking about.
ZH: 了解更多关于人们所谈论的神奇水的信息。

EN: Now that sounds like a balanced breakfast!
ZH: 现在那个听起来像是营养均衡的早餐！

EN: Nope!
ZH: 没有！

EN: You can try!
ZH: 你可以试试！

EN: Oh! Well that's a relief.
ZH: 哦，这可真是让人松了口气。

EN: What the what?! You here to steal my Sugar Bombs?!
ZH: 等等，什么？！你来这偷走了我的糖衣炸弹麦片？！

EN: Ah, Sugar Bombs. Now with 100% daily allowance of... death!
ZH: 啊，糖衣炸弹麦片。含有百分之百的……死亡成分！

EN: Didn't your momma ever teach you to share?
ZH: 你妈妈难道没教过你要学会分享吗？

EN: Sugar Bombs? Those things'll kill ya. But let me give you a shortcut.
ZH: 糖衣炸弹麦片？那东西会要了你的命。但是我给你一条捷径吧。

EN: Nah. Those things give me the jitters. I'm just here to kill you.
ZH: 不要。那东西让我浑身发毛。我来这儿只想杀了你。

EN: Hmmm... Nah. I think you're here to get yourself killed.
ZH: 嗯……不对。我觉得你来这里是为了自杀。

EN: Good guess!
ZH: 挺会猜的！

EN: I think we can arrange that.
ZH: 我觉得这个可以安排一下。

EN: Lousy job anyway!
ZH: 反正是个糟糕的工作！

EN: You here to stock the shelves? Or just get yourself killed?
ZH: 你来这里是给柜子摆满货物的吗？还是为了被杀掉？

EN: Um... Stock the shelves?
ZH: 嗯……给柜子摆货？

EN: Get myself killed?
ZH: 被杀掉？

EN: Maybe a little bit of both?
ZH: 也许二者都有？

EN: Actually, I'm the new district manager. And you're fired!
ZH: 其实，我是新的地区经理。而你被解雇了！

EN: Fine. Let's get this over with.
ZH: 行，我们来解决这个。

EN: Great, a comedian. I HATE comedians.
ZH: 呵呵，一个喜剧演员。我讨厌喜剧演员。

EN: I was just going to say the same to you!
ZH: 我正准备对你说同样的话！

EN: Well, clearly, I have a blatant disregard for the law...
ZH: 呃，显然，我公然选择忽视法律……

EN: Geez. Can't Raiders fulfill their nutritional needs without getting harassed by some do-gooder?
ZH: 天。难道掠夺者就不能在不被某个多管闲事的假善人骚扰的情况下解决温饱吗？

EN: Doesn't look like it, no.
ZH: 貌似不能。是的，不能。

EN: Do-gooder? I resemble that remark!
ZH: 好人？说的就是我！

EN: Don't make this harder than it has to be.
ZH: 不要让我们难办。

EN: Sorry, but good guys kill bad guys. It's the law of the Wasteland.
ZH: 抱歉，但好人是会杀掉坏蛋的。这是废土的法则。

EN: My Cram!!
ZH: 我的饱饱牌肉罐头！！

EN: Not going to happen, thief!
ZH: 你这个小偷，想都别想！

EN: It gets better with age! Die, food snob!
ZH: 越放越香！去死吧，你这个挑剔鬼！

EN: First you die! Then I eat more Cram!!
ZH: 你先死！这样我就有更多的饱饱牌肉罐头可以吃了！！

EN: My Cram! MINE! You hear me?! You can't have it!
ZH: 我的饱饱牌肉罐头！我的！你听到了吗？！你不可以拿走它！

EN: Cram? Seriously?
ZH: 饱饱牌肉罐头？你认真的？

EN: Ooooh. I love me some Cram. Don't mind if I do.
ZH: 哦……我喜欢来点饱饱牌肉罐头。别介意。

EN: You do realize that stuff is, like, 200 years old?
ZH: 你知道那东西起码放了……至少两百年了吧？

EN: I don't want it, honest. But I do want to kill you. Soooo...
ZH: 老实说我不想要。但我确实想要杀了你。非常……

EN: Ah. As I suspected. Vault Dweller vs. Raider. The battle eternal. Shall we, then?
ZH: 啊。就像我怀疑的，避难所居民对战掠夺者。永恒之战。那我们开始吧？

EN: Ugh. Philistine.
ZH: 呃。真是俗气。

EN: Indubitably. I am a Raider, after all. Refined palate notwithstanding.
ZH: 毋庸置疑，我终究是个掠夺者。即使我的品位这么好。

EN: Hmph. And they call ME a barbarian...
ZH: 切。他们自以为有资格叫我“野蛮人”……

EN: Greetings, my fellow connoisseur of fine pre-apocalypse cuisine. Here to peruse the bill of fare?
ZH: 你们好呀，我亲爱的前末日时代的美食鉴赏家们？来这里是想看看我们的菜单吗？

EN: Oh. Well... no. I'm here to kill you, actually.
ZH: 哦，呃……不是。我来这其实是为了杀你们的。

EN: I'm just here to get me some tasty grub.
ZH: 我来这里只是想给自己找点好吃的。

EN: Well. You're, um... not what I expected.
ZH: 呃，你……并不是我想的那样。

EN: Oh great. A foodie. How pretentious.
ZH: 哦呵呵，一个吃货。多了不起。

EN: While exploring the Wasteland, one of your Dwellers encountered a Raider-infested Super-Duper Mart. Get the jump on those jerks!
ZH: 一名探索废土的居民发现了一个被掠夺者霸占的大无敌超市。抢在这些混蛋之前动手吧！

EN: Food Fight!
ZH: 食物大战！

EN: Eliminate the Raiders.
ZH: 除掉掠夺者。

EN: Eliminate the Raiders in the Super-Duper Mart.
ZH: 除掉大无敌超市的掠夺者。

EN: Food, Glowrious Food
ZH: 食物，发光的食物

EN: Ouch. So uptight! Maybe you should just mosey on?
ZH: 嗷。太紧张了！也许你该四处溜达一下？

EN: Now that's the story, morning glory! Here. A little memento from us.
ZH: 现在才像个好故事，牵牛花！拿着，这是我们给你们的一点纪念品。

EN: Whoa, whoa. Mellow out, there, hip cat. Why don't you take a walk?
ZH: 等等，等等。放轻松，帅哥。为什么不四处看看呢？

EN: Hey there, hip cats! Welcome to the coolest settlement around.
ZH: 哈喽，潮人们！欢迎来到这一带最酷炫的定居点。

EN: We rule, everyone else drools. You dig?
ZH: 我们太厉害，其他人都只能干瞪眼，是不是挖？

EN: The only thing we “dig” is dirt. With a shovel. Because that's what digging means.
ZH: 我们唯一能“挖”的只有土。用铲子。因为那才是“挖”的意思。

EN: We ain't squares, daddy-o. We're as cool as the breeze.
ZH: 我们可不是呆子，伙计。我们像微风一样悠闲自在。

EN: You're idiots and this settlement is doomed because of you.
ZH: 你们是白痴，这个定居点就毁在你们手里了。

EN: Yeah, yeah. We know. Don't bother us. We won't bother you.
ZH: 是是，我们知道。别找我们麻烦，这样我们也不会找你们麻烦。

EN: Ha! You're all right, smoothskins. Here. Take this.
ZH: 哈！你说的对，“光滑皮肤”。来，拿着这个。

EN: We're NOT zombies. Just leave!
ZH: 我们不是僵尸啊。你们走吧！

EN: Hey there, smoothskins! We didn't think you'd make it.
ZH: 嘿，那个有光滑皮肤的！我们没想到你能逃过这一劫。

EN: Not many people would stop by a settlement run by us Ghouls.
ZH: 可没多少人会来拜访由我们这种尸鬼经营的定居点。

EN: Just keep your distance, Ghouls, and everything will be fine.
ZH: 尸鬼们，和我们保持距离就行。其他的都好说。

EN: Hey, always “cool to be Ghoul”, you know what we mean?
ZH: 拜托，永远都要以“我是尸鬼”而自豪，你明白我们的意思吗？

EN: Agh! Zombies!
ZH: 啊！僵尸！

EN: A settlement in a library! Now keep quiet while you're here.
ZH: 一个图书馆里的定居点！现在请保持安静。

EN: Good. Glad to see you can behave.
ZH: 很好。很高兴看到你们还能控制住自己。

EN: I hate you. So much.
ZH: 我讨厌你。非常讨厌。

EN: Shh! Keep your voice down. This is a library!
ZH: 嘘！小点声。这里可是图书馆！

EN: We were told this was a settlement.
ZH: 我们听说这里是个定居点。

EN: (Remain Silent)
ZH: （保持安静）

EN: WHAT? WE COULDN'T HEAR YOU BECAUSE WE'RE TOO LOUD!
ZH: 什么？我们听不见因为我们太吵了！

EN: Hey, we get it. But we're the good guys now. Honest.
ZH: 嘿，我们懂的。但讲真心话，我们现在是好人了。

EN: Well, it's not as fun, but it's clean. Thanks for understanding. Take this.
ZH: 嗯，没有那么有趣，但至少很干净了。谢谢你们的理解。收下这个吧。

EN: I think we're all lucky that's the case. Excuse us.
ZH: 我想事情发展成这个样子是我们大家的幸运。请见谅。

EN: Hey there, Dwellers. No need to be alarmed. We're not Raiders anymore. We're retired.
ZH: 听着，居民们，没必要紧张。我们已经不做掠夺者啦，我们退休了。

EN: A bunch of us decided to try earning our living the honest way.
ZH: 我们中的一些人决定用另一种方式生活——正当工作赚取日常所需。

EN: Just keep your hands where we can see them.
ZH: 把你们的手放在我们能看见的地方。

EN: Good for you! Honest work is way better than Raiding!
ZH: 太棒了！勤劳工作比当掠夺者去抢要好得多！

EN: You're lucky we aren't here to kill you.
ZH: 你们应该感到幸运，我们来这里不是为了杀你们的。

EN: Righteous. Here's one of my personal favorites. Catch you cats next time!
ZH: 有品味。这是我个人最喜欢的一件。下次见啦，伙计们！

EN: Oh, I hear that. Wear it with pride!
ZH: 哦，这话我爱听。穿上它，引以为傲吧！

EN: I hear ya, daddy-o, I hear ya. Here you go.
ZH: 我听到了，公子哥，我听到啦。这就来了。

EN: Suppose we can let some parts go. Enjoy.
ZH: 我想我们应该能抛开一些东西吧。好好享受。

EN: Vault Dwellers, huh? Having a blast in our little homestead?
ZH: 避难所居民是吧？在我们这个小地方玩得开心吗？

EN: You Dwellers are cool, so we're thinking we do some trading, dig?
ZH: 你们这些居民挺不错的，所以我们想和你们做点交易，如何？

EN: We can send you back with something, but you gotta choose or lose.
ZH: 我们可以回赠你们一些东西，但是要么留要么丢。

EN: We can always use some weapons.
ZH: 武器对我们来说总是有用的。

EN: We need new outfits. The snazzier the better.
ZH: 我们需要新的装备。越时髦越好。

EN: We wouldn't mind a few pick-me-ups.
ZH: 我们不介意来点酒。

EN: How about some junk? We're feeling crafty.
ZH: 来点杂物怎么样？我们想造点东西。

EN: All right. Here's what we've got.
ZH: 好啊，这些是我们有的东西。
